6ec0b07b850ff8cd0c13.text: You have already analyzed the issue on poverty in the picture analysis you did in the previous activity. What are common types of issues in the society? What type of issue is poverty?

75bbd424283adeb49fca.text: As you read and listen, reflect on whether you have seen, heard, or experienced the issues presented in this section.

46da89128e74e1b73887.text: An issue is an important problem or topic that people in the society argue about or discuss since it negatively affects many people in the society. It could be a social, moral, or economic issue.

2d6ee5decfc270f2808c.text: What are common issues in the society?

66c18af6d6f19ffb57e3.text: The following are common issues in the society:

rows: A. SOCIAL ISSUES prevent the society from functioning at the most desirable level.
An issue becomes a social issue under the following circumstances:
The issue involves people in the society.
The public, as a whole, recognizes the situation as a problem.
A large segment of the population sees the situation as a valid concern.
The situation can be alleviated through the joint actions of the citizens.
1cab47debddd8a06762d.text: A. SOCIAL ISSUES prevent the society from functioning at the most desirable level.  An issue becomes a social issue under the following circumstances:      The issue involves people in the society.  The public, as a whole, recognizes the situation as a problem.  A large segment of the population sees the situation as a valid concern.  The situation can be alleviated through the joint actions of the citizens.

c63b44abac690eb1ddb7.text: The image reflects an issue on drug

6eca0aac5e9aa98a7a0a.text: prohibited drugs can cause the drug user to neglect his responsibility towards his family, children, career, education, and health. Thus, it is a social problem that can adversely affect not only the lives of the drug addicts, but also their families and the entire community.

45c3e949b18e4fc291e1.text: The image reflects the issue on

d4af8142a88361e0899a.text: Crime is a social issue and at the

b7c62c1a5453c4f0697e.text: same time a moral issue since it affects the safety and security of citizens and it is against the values and beliefs of the people. It is prohibited by the law as it is harmful or offensive to the people or the society.

7885f5c91d5349e93d08.text: The image reflects the issue on

b471c2112d2962ab61fe.text: poverty. Poverty is described by the World Bank Organization as hunger, lack of shelter, being sick, and not being able to see a doctor. It is further defined as not having access to school, not having a job, fear of the future, and living a kind of hand-to-mouth existence.

467f58a2815451246bab.text: It is a social problem since a large

63ccd82a16bdd1a18fcf.text: segment of the population experiences such situation and sees it as a valid concern.
